item.title: Honeymoon over for Wallabies coach Kiss after another bout of 'Bledis-woe'
item.description: Back-to-back thrashings by New Zealand have triggered alarm bells for the Wallabies' prospects at their home Rugby World Cup and heaped pressure on coach Les Kiss to engineer an immediate rebound on the season-ending tour of Europe.
item.dc:creator: Ian Ransom
item.content:encoded: Back-to-back thrashings by New Zealand have triggered alarm bells for the Wallabies' prospects at their home Rugby World Cup and heaped pressure on coach Les Kiss to engineer an immediate rebound on the season-ending tour of Europe. Kiss banked plenty of goodwill after going unbeaten in his first five tests in charge, and a crowd of 73,000 flocked to Stadium Australia on Saturday hoping for better from the hosts following their 50-19 humiliation away at Eden Park. However, most left frustrated as the Wallabies [USN:L1N463029 TEXT:"crashed to a 43-21 defeat"] and a 13th straight loss to their trans-Tasman Sea rivals, underscoring the huge gap they have to close before hosting the World Cup next year. Kiss is the only latest Australia coach to endure an All Blacks whitewash, with the same fate befalling predecessors Joe Schmidt (2024-25), Eddie Jones (2023) and Dave Rennie (2021-22), the current New Zealand boss. But no Wallabies coach has endured a worse record in a single two-test series against their neighbours, with this year's aggregate losing margin of 53 points eclipsing the previous benchmark of 44 points during the 1996 Tri-Nations under Greg Smith. With New Zealand locking away the trans-Tasman Bledisloe Cup for a 24th straight year after Eden Park, Australia's standing as World Cup contenders has plummeted. "The bubble has well and truly burst," rugby journalist Tom Decent wrote in the Sydney Morning Herald. Depleted in the centres and at flyhalf due to injuries, Australia were not at full strength at Stadium Australia but Rennie was also missing a number of top players including hooker Asafo Aumua and flyhalves Richie Mo'unga and Ruben Love. Schmidt gave test debuts to more than 20 players in his two-and-a-half years in charge before handing the squad over to Kiss, but the Wallabies remain vulnerable in key positions when injuries strike. Kiss's squad for the second tranche of Nations Championship matches against England, Scotland and Wales in November will be closely scrutinised when announced this week. The Wallabies will be relieved to have Len Ikitau return to the midfield for the opening test against England at Twickenham on November 8 and flyhalf Ben Donaldson is expected to be available after recovering from an upper leg injury. First-choice flyhalf Carter Gordon may have less chance following his broken leg last month, though Kiss was pleased with rookie Declan Meredith's performance at number 10 in Sydney. "I think that's a really good positive to come out of the game, to see what Declan did," said Kiss. There could be further reinforcements from overseas-based players who were unavailable for the Bledisloe tests, including loose forward Tom Hooper and prop Taniela Tupou. Hulking lock Will Skelton will likely be a part of Kiss's World Cup plans but not for the November tests while he recovers from an Achilles injury.

item.title: Global food inflation is expected to intensify as supply shocks pile up
item.description: Muhamad Yasin, a 63-year-old parking attendant in central Jakarta, says he has cut back on meals as rising prices have put food staples beyond his reach.
item.dc:creator: Naveen Thukral, Bernadette Christina
item.content:encoded: Muhamad Yasin, a 63-year-old parking attendant in central Jakarta, says he has cut back on meals as rising prices have put food staples beyond his reach. "I used to be able to get rice, tempeh and tofu for 7,000 to 8,000 rupiah ($0.39 to $0.44). Now it's 15,000 rupiah," said Yasin, who earns 200,000 to 300,000 rupiah a week, beside the minimarket where he watches over parked motorcycles. Global food inflation is poised to accelerate in the coming months and persist well into 2027, as war-related shipping disruptions and El Nino-driven drought squeeze cereal supplies, putting additional pressure on vulnerable consumers like Yasin, a father of four. In Indonesia, rice prices have already jumped to record highs amid forecasts of delayed rains, while the cost of bread in Egypt has risen by a quarter and sugar prices in India hit an all-time high as the weakest monsoon in over a decade curbed production. "All this has put considerable pressure on the system," said Maximo Torero, chief economist at the United Nations' Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO). "We will see a bigger impact towards the end of the year, at the beginning of next year and potentially throughout next year." The world's poorest consumers are being hit the hardest as food prices rise sharply in low- and middle-income countries across the Middle East, North Africa and Asia, where food accounts for a larger share of household spending. According to the World Bank, food prices in the September quarter outpaced headline inflation in 22% of the 150 countries it analysed, up from 14% in the previous quarter. The [USN:L1N44W08J TEXT:"FAO"] Food Price Index, which tracks monthly changes in a basket of internationally traded commodities, averaged 136 points in September, the highest reading since November 2022. Rising prices heighten the risk of social unrest and could prompt governments that are key suppliers to impose export bans, further exacerbating shortages. MULTIPLE SUPPLY SHOCKS Attacks on Black Sea grain infrastructure have disrupted [USN:L4N4580IP TEXT:"wheat shipments"], forcing top importers Egypt and Indonesia to seek alternative supplies, while Red Sea insecurity diverts vessels onto longer, costlier routes around Africa. The US-Israeli war on Iran has raised fuel prices and disrupted fertiliser exports through the Strait of Hormuz, driving up farming costs even as dry El Nino weather reduces output in India and Southeast Asia. Wheat prices are up more than 30% in 2026, while rice prices in key Asian exporting countries have risen 10% to 13% in spite of large inventories. Fertiliser prices are off peaks reached earlier in the Iran war, but they remain elevated. "Rising inflation, particularly food inflation, is a reality," said Manish Tiwary, chairman and managing director of [USN:L4N4610KU TEXT:"Nestle"] India (NEST.NS) , citing "a challenging environment" that is due in part to higher commodity costs. In Egypt, prices of unsubsidised bread have risen to around 5 Egyptian pounds ($0.093) for a big loaf from 4 pounds in July, while the price of cooking oil has climbed about 40% in the United Arab Emirates. Vegetable oil in Indonesia has jumped 7% this year, even though the country is the world's biggest palm oil producer. Prices of sugar, onions and pulses in India jumped more than 10% in September from a month earlier due to production shortfalls. For baker Sayed Abdel Hamid Mohamed in downtown Cairo, it is not just the price of flour. "If you bring in a skilled worker, it costs you a lot," he said. "Electricity, water, yeast and the materials we use to produce the loaf of bread for consumers have all risen." Tarek Azab, a customer at the bakery, said prices have been continuously rising, "not once, twice, or three times," in the past few years. Freight rates have risen about 50% on some key global routes such as the Black Sea to Southeast Asia as oil prices and war premiums surge. INFLATION CATALYST While food prices have been rising since late 2025, dwindling local supplies and higher commodity costs feeding through to consumers threaten to accelerate inflation. Key importers in the Middle East and Africa that held off on buying after strong local harvests now need to return to the world's markets, potentially triggering a surge in demand. "In a couple of months, there could be a significant new wave of demand as importers return to the market," said Alexander Karavaytsev, a senior economist at the International Grains Council in London. The cushion from record global grain inventories is wearing thin, the FAO's Torero said. "Stocks and good harvests in previous seasons have provided a buffer, but those buffers are starting to come under pressure," he said. "That means commodity price increases could become more pronounced." Food processors that typically buy raw materials on three- to six-month contracts are now renewing those deals at higher prices, with weaker local currencies magnifying the costs. "Shipping costs have also increased and when converted into rupiah, the impact is amplified by the weakening of the Indonesian currency," said Franciscus Welirang, a director of PT Indofood, the country's largest food company. On top of higher prices, food processors are experiencing difficulties in securing supplies, traders said. Several wheat millers in Indonesia are running their units below capacity as the Russia-Ukraine war has reduced cargo arrivals, said a senior executive at a flour milling company in Jakarta who did not want to be named as they were not authorised to speak to the media. Indonesian wheat arrivals dropped 41% to 491,000 metric tons in September from a year earlier, Kpler data showed. For now, soybean and corn inventories are ample, with future supplies hinging on production in the US and South America, although higher oil prices have supported both crops because of their growing use in biofuels. Favourable southern hemisphere wheat harvests are expected and any downside risk to output in exporters like Australia and Argentina could add a new bullish element to prices, the IGC's Karavaytsev said. "There is significant upside risk in prices," he said. ($1 = 18,000.0000 Indonesian rupiah) ($1 = 53.5000 Egyptian pounds)

item.title: Mali forces, Russian backers kill scores of civilians in drone strikes, report says
item.description: Mali's armed forces and their Russian backers utilized some "apparent indiscriminate" drone strikes and other abuses as part of an ramped-up offensive against insurgents in recent months that has killed scores of civilians, Human Rights Watch said in a report on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Mali's armed forces and their Russian backers utilized some "apparent indiscriminate" drone strikes and other abuses as part of an ramped-up offensive against insurgents in recent months that has killed scores of civilians, Human Rights Watch said in a report on Monday. The drone strikes and resulting civilian casualties more than doubled between April and August, compared to the same period a year ago, the report said citing ACLED data, in response to nationwide attacks by the regional al-Qaeda affiliate, known as JNIM, and by Tuareg-led separatists. The insurgent [USN:L6N41A0CL TEXT:"attacks"] launched on April 25 killed Mali's defence minister and hit multiple towns and cities as well as the main airport in Bamako, underscoring the government's struggle to improve security in the landlocked West African country. Mali's military leaders, who seized power in coups in 2020 and 2021, have turned to Russia for support in their fight against insurgents, and they enlisted the Russian paramilitary group Africa Corps in their response to the April attacks. The data from US-based conflict monitor ACLED showed Malian forces and Africa Corps carried out 47 drone strikes resulting in 94 civilian deaths from April-August, up from 22 strikes resulting in 44 civilian deaths a year earlier. STRIKES HIT CATTLE MARKET, HEALTH CENTRE, REPORT SAYS Some of the incidents in the report were "apparent indiscriminate drone strikes," including an August 19 strike on a cattle market in the Bandiagara region of central Mali that killed six men, and a pre-dawn strike on July 29 on a health centre in the northern region of Kidal, near the Algerian border, Human Rights Watch said. The report also documented abuses that did not involve drones, including an incident on July 12 in the Segou region in which it said soldiers shot and killed five young girls they mistook for attackers. A Malian army spokesperson did not respond to a request for comment. Human Rights Watch said it received no response to a letter sent on August 5 to Mali's new defence minister that detailed the group's findings. Mali has previously denied killing civilians in counterinsurgency operations. The Russian embassy in Bamako did not immediately respond to a request for comment on Africa Corps's involvement. The Human Rights Watch report also documented abuses by JNIM and the Tuareg-led separatists, including the execution of [USN:L6N43V13I TEXT:"19 soldiers"] in the northern Gao region in July. JNIM's Sharia Committee told HRW that the killings "did in fact take place" but denied ordering them and said "it is not our policy to do such things". The Tuareg-led Azawad Liberation Front denied executing soldiers.

item.title: World faces nature reality check at UN biodiversity conference
item.description: World leaders, diplomats and nature experts gather in Armenia this week to assess lagging efforts to halt biodiversity loss, with countries off track on most global targets and divisions over funding still unresolved.
item.dc:creator: Virginia Furness
item.content:encoded: World leaders, diplomats and nature experts gather in Armenia this week to assess lagging efforts to halt biodiversity loss, with countries off track on most global targets and divisions over funding still unresolved. The 17th UN "Conference of the Parties", dubbed COP17, is the first major review of progress under the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework, the landmark 2022 agreement that aims to protect 30% of land and sea by 2030. The climate-focused COP31 begins on November 9 in Antalya, Turkey. While the world is likely to reach an estimated 27.5% of land protection by 2030, scientists say many of the broader goals needed to halt biodiversity loss remain well off track. From pesticide use to unsustainable fishing and subsidies for a host of damaging activities, the deterioration of ecosystems threatens food production, water security and economic stability across the planet. Countries are currently not on track to meet 22 of the 23 goals set out in the Kunming-Montreal framework, a draft UN report showed. While the UN says 144 countries including Brazil and China have so far created action plans, who pays and how much towards a $30 billion public finance goal is less clear and will be central to two weeks of talks in Armenia's capital Yerevan. The broader goal is to mobilise at least $200 billion per year by 2030. SUBSIDY REFORM Another major focus is reforming $500 billion a year of subsidies for activities that damage nature, with governments urged to set a two-year timeline to identify and redirect the most damaging ones. That could, for example, include those that encourage farmers to cut down rainforest or the offer of state discounts on synthetic fertilisers and chemical pesticides which damage soil and water. Doing so would help governments address nature loss and related issues like food and energy security without committing more public money at a time of war, energy crises and other inflationary pressures. "This isn't primarily a story about conservation," said Eva Zabey, CEO of the non-profit Business for Nature at a media briefing. "It's an economic, fiscal, political and competitiveness story, which is grounded in resilience and resource security." More than 130 businesses including retailer H&M (HMb.ST) and consumer goods company Nestle (NESN.S) issued an open letter ahead of the talks urging governments to set clearer policies and a plan to reform incentives over the next 12 months, arguing that it would help make it more attractive to invest. Subsidies ultimately cost governments between $11 trillion and $24.7 trillion a year, non-profit Conservation International estimates, as they often pay twice - once for the subsidies and again to patch up the damage that follows including cleaning up pollution, treating illness and repairing infrastructure. BIGGER ROLE FOR PRIVATE SECTOR With public money tight, many are looking to the private sector to play a bigger role, including through the Cali Fund. That fund was set up in 2025 to get companies which rely on digital databases of biological samples for their products, such as in the pharmaceutical, cosmetic and commercial agriculture industries, to help pay to preserve nature. Details still to be ironed out include how funds should be shared between countries and Indigenous communities, and whether companies should contribute based on total revenue when only part of their business relies on these genetic resources. For Cristián Samper, managing director and leader of Nature Solutions at the Bezos Earth Fund, the talks are also an opportunity for governments to do more to halt the extinction of species. "We know recovery is possible. The decisions we make in Armenia should give more conservation teams the backing to make it happen," he said.

item.title: NFL injury roundup: Falcons LB Kendal Daniels hospitalized after injury vs. Bears
item.description: Atlanta Falcons rookie linebacker Kendal Daniels left the game against the Chicago Bears on a stretcher on Sunday, a day when several frontline players made early exits due to injuries.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Atlanta Falcons rookie linebacker Kendal Daniels left the game against the Chicago Bears on a stretcher on Sunday, a day when several frontline players made early exits due to injuries. According to the Falcons, Daniels was conscious and had full movement of all extremities. He was taken to Grady Memorial Hospital in Atlanta for further evaluation. "So far, the reports are good," Falcons coach Kevin Stefanski said after the game, a 31-23 home loss to Chicago. "He did have movement in his extremities out there on the field. I thought the medical staff did an outstanding job of getting him safely off the field. So all reports so far are good and we'll continue to pray that they remain good." Daniels stumbled into a low tackle on Chicago tight end Colston Loveland, his facemask colliding with Loveland's knee. Daniels then rolled over while putting his face toward the turf. He remained motionless for several minutes as medical personnel attended to him. Daniels, a fourth-round draft pick last April out of Oklahoma, has started on defense in each of his first six NFL games. He entered Sunday with one sack among his 22 tackles and had seven tackles against the Bears before departing. The Falcons also lost linebacker Divine Deablo (arm) and defensive back Billy Bowman Jr. (hamstring) to early exits. --Philadelphia Eagles edge rusher Nolan Smith sustained a concussion in the first half of the team's 25-14 home loss against the Carolina Panthers. Smith was rushing the passer with 12:45 left in the second quarter when he was chip-blocked by Carolina running back Chuba Hubbard. Smith fell to the ground and was checked for a concussion in the aftermath of the play. He did not return to the game. Smith recorded a first-half sack to bring his season total to three. That matches the 2025 total for the 2023 first-round draft pick. He now has 13.5 sacks for his career. He finished with three total tackles in the game and one quarterback hit. Philadelphia defensive tackle Jordan Davis (ankle) and running back Carson Steele (shoulder) also were ruled out during the game. --Chargers wide receiver Ladd McConkey was ruled out with a concussion in the first half of Los Angeles' 22-6 road loss to the Kansas City Chiefs. McConkey underwent further evaluation after being hit near midfield midway through the first quarter following a 17-yard completion from Justin Herbert. McConkey has 13 catches for 200 yards and one touchdown in five games this season. --Chiefs right tackle Jaylon Moore is in concussion protocol, the team announced after he exited in the second quarter of the win over the Chargers. Moore has started all five games this season --Baltimore Ravens wide receiver Rashod Bateman (shoulder) left in the second quarter and did not return in the 13-10 road loss to the Cleveland Browns. He did not record a catch on his lone target, keeping his total at 16 on 22 targets for 233 yards and one touchdown in six games (four starts). --Browns starting safety Grant Delpit was placed in concussion protocol after exiting in the first quarter against the Ravens. Delpit made two tackles, raising his season total to 25 in six games (all starts). --Houston Texans starting safety Reed Blankenship (concussion) exited in the first half of their 34-31 victory over the Jacksonville Jaguars in London. He had five tackles, for a new total of 45 in six games (five starts). --Jaguars starting safety Antonio Johnson (ankle) made six tackles, including one tackle for loss, before he exited against the Texans. --Indianapolis cornerback Sauce Gardner, a two-time first-team All-Pro, injured his calf in the team's 26-20 home loss to the Tennessee Titans. The Colts also saw early exits for punter Rigoberto Sanchez (foot) and kickoff returner Anthony Gould (concussion protocol). --Titans safety Tony Adams (ankle) made 12 tackles, including his first sack this season, and defended a pass before exiting in the fourth quarter. He made his second start in six games. --Kicker Blake Grupe's debut with the Los Angeles Rams was forgettable as he injured his knee while making a tackle in the first quarter and was ruled out of the 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals. Grupe was signed this week to replace Harrison Mevis. Grupe made a 44-yard field goal before he got hurt on the ensuing kickoff while attempting to tackle returner Devin Duvernay. Grupe was replaced by punter Ethan Evans, who made one extra point in his only kicking attempt. Rams wide receiver Davante Adams appeared to favor his left knee while hobbling to the sideline on the team's final offensive drive of the game. Coach Sean McVay gave no update on the apparent non-contact injury after the game on Adams, 33, a three-time first-team All-Pro and six-time Pro Bowl selection. Adams has 30 receptions for 480 yards and four touchdowns in six games after leading the league with 14 TD catches in 14 games last season. --New England's offensive line dealt with a slew of injuries as left guard Alijah-Vera-Tucker (hamstring), right tackle Morgan Moses (ankle) and right guard Ben Brown (knee) were ruled out during the Patriots' 26-19 win over the New York Jets. Wide receiver Romeo Doubs (shoulder) exited after catching one pass for a 42-yard touchdown in the first quarter, Moses and Vera-Tucker left in the second and Brown in the fourth. --New York Giants cornerback Greg Newsome II (concussion) and wide receiver Darnell Mooney (neck) were ruled out during the 34-27 loss to the New Orleans Saints. Newsome, a starter, had three tackles and one pass breakup before leaving in the third quarter. Mooney had no receptions on two targets and ran once for 20 yards. --Saints starting right guard Cesar Ruiz (knee) exited late in the first half, and starting cornerback Kool-Aid McKinstry left because of what coach Kellen Moore said was a migraine. McKinstry had one tackle. --Dallas Cowboys wide receiver KaVontae Turpin (rib) was ruled out and linebacker Dee Winters (ankle) was questionable to return to the game Sunday night against the host Green Bay Packers. Turpin returned one kickoff for 25 yards. --Field Level Media

item.title: Victoria's Secret Fashion Show struts through the seasons in Los Angeles
item.description: The Victoria's Secret Fashion Show returned to Los Angeles on Sunday with a celebration of the changing seasons, as the brand's signature angel-winged models swept down the runway in elaborate flower-petal, snowflake and gleaming metallic creations.
item.dc:creator: Danielle Broadway
item.content:encoded: The Victoria's Secret Fashion Show returned to Los Angeles on Sunday with a celebration of the changing seasons, as the brand's signature angel-winged models swept down the runway in elaborate flower-petal, snowflake and gleaming metallic creations. "I actually did the four seasons, and then I added in a second Winter spot," Adam Selman, the show's executive creative director, told Reuters on the pink carpet ahead of the event. "So you'll see Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter one and Winter two, with PINK in the middle," he said, referring to the lingerie company's youth-focused sub-brand PINK, which had its own dedicated segment. The annual runway spectacle, known for its star-studded casting, extravagant costumes and musical performances, drew celebrity guests including Lisa Rinna and Kylie Jenner. Making her Victoria's Secret Fashion Show debut, Jenner wore the brand's famed $50 million Fantasy Bra, originally modeled by Swedish model Elsa Hosk in 2018. Watching from the audience were her mother, Kris Jenner, and boyfriend Timothée Chalamet. An all-female lineup of performers, including Megan Moroney, Tate McRae, KATSEYE and Megan Thee Stallion, each embraced a distinct color palette that mirrored the night's larger fantasy theme. Country singer Moroney made a dramatic entrance with a glittering guitar and oversized fuzzy pink wings, paired with a floor-length gown featuring a sweeping side slit and towering pink platform heels. Pop star McRae took the runway in a red fishnet corset, matching pumps and airy tulle wings that billowed behind her as she performed. At one point, she shared the catwalk with model Gigi Hadid. Global girl group KATSEYE performed their viral hit "Pinky Up" during the PINK segment. The members wore a mix of black fishnet stockings, shimmering pink-and-black corsets and charm-adorned body chains, a look that underscored the youthful, playful spirit of the collection. Megan Thee Stallion leaned into a futuristic silver look, wearing sharp metallic wings, a shimmering bra and shrug, silver heels and fishnets as she performed hits including "Body." The Victoria's Secret Fashion Show has traveled to cities including London, Paris, Shanghai and Cannes since its debut in 1995, but New York has remained its longtime home. That makes its return to Los Angeles a relatively rare stop for the globally watched production. (This story has been refiled to correct the dateline.)

item.title: プーチン氏、11月の米ロ中首脳会談提案と米紙 ウクライナ巡り
item.description: ［１８日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１８日　ロイター］ - ロシアのプーチン大統領が、４年に及ぶウクライナ紛争をロシア側に有利な形で終結させるための交渉を行うため、トランプ米大統領および中国の習近平国家主席との首脳会談を来月開催することを提案した。米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）が、元ロシア情報機関幹部の話として１８日報じた。

ＷＳＪによると、プーチン氏は、９日のトランプ氏との電話会談で提案したという。また、協議に詳しい関係者の話として、ロシア大統領府が１１月１８─１９日に中国の深センで開かれるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議に合わせた３者協議の開催を提案したと報じた。

ペスコフ大統領報道官はＷＳＪに対し、会談の可能性を巡って協議が行われていることを認めた。同氏はＷＳＪに「会談そのものや、その議題性について、まだはっきりとした共通認識はない。ただ、３者ともこうした会談が開かれる可能性は認めている」と述べた。

米政府高官はＷＳＪに対し、トランプ氏は米中ロの首脳会談に同意していないものの、この案を受け入れる可能性はあると語った。

ホワイトハウスはロイターのコメント要請に応じていない。ロシア大統領府（クレムリン）には連絡がつかなかった。在ワシントンのロシア、中国両大使館もコメント要請に応じていない。

item.title: 午前のドルは157円後半中心に売買交錯、テーマ定まらず方向感乏しい
item.description:
(デートラインを修正しました。)
Atsuko Aoyama
[東京 １９日 ロイター] - 午前のドルは１５７円後...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
午前のドルは157円後半中心に売買交錯、テーマ定まらず方向感乏しい 12:32 配信

米ドル紙幣とグラフ。8月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

(デートラインを修正しました。)

Atsuko Aoyama

[東京 １９日 ロイター] - 午前のドルは１５７円後半を中心に売買が交錯した。朝方はユーロ／ドル反発の影響でドル／円は下押ししたが、底堅さも残り１５８円台を回復する場面もあった。ＡＩ（人工知能）企業の信用不安やフランスの政治不安はくすぶるものの、過度な懸念には至らず、テーマが定まらない中で方向感の乏しい値動きが続いている。

・ドルは１５７円後半ー１５８円近辺で売買交錯

・強弱材料混在、リスクオフ懸念の一方で原油は高止まり

・ＡＩ企業の信用不安、今後予定される決算次第か

・デモ拡大したフランスの問題も過度な懸念には至らず、ユーロ／ドルはいったん反発

・決算によってＡＩ企業の選別が進むとの見方も

・米ＷＴＩ原油先物は１バレル１００ドル台を維持

＜りそな銀行　資金証券部市場トレーディング室　広兼千晶氏＞

「全体的にテーマが定まらない。重要な指標発表などがなく、引き続きＡＩ企業の信用不安やフランス問題が注目だが、懸念はくすぶりつつも過度ではない」

「ハイパースケーラー系の企業の決算が今後予定されており、ＡＩ企業に対する信用不安が払しょくされるかは決算次第になるだろう」

「懸念が広範に広がるかは疑問。今までは金利が高止まりしそうな中でＡＩなら全て買い、となっていたものが選別に向かいつつあるとみている」

item.title: ベトナム、欧州自由貿易連合の4カ国とＦＴＡ締結
item.description: [１８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１８日 ロイター] - ノルウェー、スイス、アイスランド、リヒテンシュタインの欧州自由貿易連合（ＥＦＴＡ）加盟国はベトナムと自由貿易協定（ＦＴＡ）を締結した。ノルウェーとベトナムの政府が１８日発表した。

・ベトナム商工省によると、ハノイで協定の署名が行われた。

・ノルウェー政府は声明で、協定発効時に同国のベトナム向け輸出の約半分が無関税となり、７年以内にその割合が９８％超に達すると説明した。

・長らく停滞していた自由貿易交渉は昨年、米国の関税を巡って世界的に緊張が高まる中で再開され、今年７月に妥結した。

・ベトナム商工省によると、同国はＥＦＴＡ市場に主に水産物、履物、繊維製品、機械・機器、電子機器・部品を輸出し、産業用機械・機器、化学品、医薬品、生産用原材料を輸入している。ＥＦＴＡ加盟国との貿易額は年平均２０億ドル。

item.title: 中国新築住宅価格、9月も前月比0.1％下落
item.description: [北京 １９日 ロイター] - 中国国家統計局が１９日発表したデータに基づくロイターの算出によると、９月の新築住宅価...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国新築住宅価格、9月も前月比0.1％下落 12:24 配信

[北京 １９日 ロイター] - 中国国家統計局が１９日発表したデータに基づくロイターの算出によると、９月の新築住宅価格は前月比０．１％下落した。下げ幅は８月と同じで、政策支援が住宅需要の広範な回復にはまだつながっていないことが示唆された。

前年比では２．８％下落。下落率は８月の３．０％から縮小した。

前月比・前年比ともに上昇が見られない状態が３年以上続いている。

大都市における新築・中古住宅価格は安定化の兆しを見せ続けている。上海での住宅購入規制のさらなる緩和や、８月に発表された補助金などのインセンティブに後押しされたものとみられる。

しかし、中小都市では、新築住宅と中古住宅の価格が前月比、前年比ともに下落を続けた。

別のデータによると、１─９月には、不動産投資と住宅販売のいずれも、縮小ペースが加速したことが示された。

item.title: 情報漏えい、企業の16％が経験 サイバー攻撃に警戒感＝帝国データ
item.description:
Kentaro Okasaka
[東京 １９日 ロイター] - 帝国データバンクは１９日、これまでに情報漏えいや、漏...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
情報漏えい、企業の16％が経験　サイバー攻撃に警戒感＝帝国データ 12:21 配信

サイバー攻撃のイラスト。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 １９日 ロイター] - 帝国データバンクは１９日、これまでに情報漏えいや、漏えいの可能性のある事案が発生したことがあると答えた企業の割合が１６．２％だったとの企業アンケート結果を公表した。直近１年以内の発生は５．５％だった。メール誤送信など人為ミスの他、サイバー攻撃による被害もみられ、企業からは警戒する声が多く聞かれた。

大企業では３０．２％が情報漏えいを経験していた。帝国データは、取り扱う情報量が多いことに加え、不正アクセスなどを検知・把握する体制が整備されているため発覚件数も多いと分析している。サイバー攻撃への警戒は強いものの「多額の費用がかかるため十分な対応は容易ではない」といった声が聞かれたという。

中小企業では１４．３％が経験。「狙われる対象にもならないと思うが、昨今のサイバー攻撃のニュースを耳にすると他人事ではない気がする」「中小零細企業では対策して も限界があり難しい」などの声が出ていた。

一方、１４．８％の企業は発生有無が「分からない」と回答、十分に把握できていない状況も浮かび上がった。

アンケートは９ー１４日にインターネットで実施し、１３２８社から有効回答を得た。

item.title: Monterrey gana como local a Pachuca en torneo mexicano
item.description: Monterrey venció el domingo 2-1 a Pachuca en el cierre de la duodécima jornada del torneo Apertura del fútbol mexicano.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Monterrey venció el domingo 2-1 a Pachuca en el cierre de la duodécima jornada del torneo Apertura del fútbol mexicano. Con su quinto triunfo en el torneo, los "Rayados" de Monterrey llegaron a 17 puntos para ubicarse en el octavo lugar general, dentro de la zona que da acceso a la postemporada o liguilla. Los clubes que finalizan en los primeros ocho lugares de la tabla general al final de las 17 jornadas de la temporada regular clasifican a la postemporada. En el partido, disputado en el estadio BBVA de Monterrey, el equipo local se puso en ventaja a los 13 minutos cuando el uruguayo Diego Rossi definió de derecha en el área chica después de que el portero Carlos Moreno rechazó un tiro penal al argentino Lucas Ocampos. El segundo gol del club dirigido por el argentino Matías Almeyda llegó a los 16 minutos cuando Jesús "Tecatito" Corona definió picando el balón ante la salida del portero tras recibir uin pase de Ocampos en una jugada de contragolpe. Pachuca descontó a los 75 minutos por conducto del venezolano Salomón Rondón, quien remató con la cabeza un centro enviado desde el sector derecho. En los partidos disputados el sábado, el vigente campeón Cruz Azul goleó 5-0 a Bravos de Ciudad Juárez. América se consolidó como el líder general tras ganar 5-3 de visita a León. Las "Águilas" del América llegaron a 24 puntos en la cima de la tabla general, donde le siguen Toluca y Atlas con 21 unidades. Santos Laguna registró su quinto triunfo consecutivo al vencer 5-0 a Querétaro. En tanto, Guadalajara y Tigres UANL empataron 1-1. El viernes, Pumas UNAM ganó 2-1 de visita al Atlante, Atlas derrotó 2-0 de visita a Necaxa, y Tijuana y Puebla empataron 0-0.

item.title: 欧州検討のＥＶ法案、日本企業の公平な競争確保へ対応＝官房長官
item.description: ［東京 １９日 ロイター］ - 木原稔官房長官は１９日午前の記者会見で、欧州連合（ＥＵ）が検討する欧州製電気自動車（...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州検討のＥＶ法案、日本企業の公平な競争確保へ対応＝官房長官 12:17 配信

ブリュッセルの欧州委員会本部。4月撮影。REUTERS/Yves Herman

［東京　１９日　ロイター］ - 木原稔官房長官は１９日午前の記者会見で、欧州連合（ＥＵ）が検討する欧州製電気自動車（ＥＶ）の優遇措置案で独仏が合意したとの報道を巡り、ＥＵ加盟国で審議中の法案に関するものであり、政府として日本企業が不利益を被ることがないようＥＵ側に懸念を伝達してきており、ＥＵ市場での公平な競争環境を確保するため適切に対応していくと述べた。

木原官房長官はまた、この日の国会答弁で高市首相が「国債発行を否定するものではない」と発言したことについて、あくまで予算編成全体についての答弁であり、消費減税の財源として特例公債を発行しないとする政府の方針に変わりはないと説明した。

item.title: Gold edges higher on softer oil; Fed rate outlook in focus
item.description: Gold prices edged higher on Monday as softer oil prices offered support, while investors assessed the chances of a Federal Reserve interest rate hike later this year and looked for fresh signals on the US central bank's policy trajectory.
item.dc:creator: Sukanya Mitra
item.content:encoded: Gold prices edged higher on Monday as softer oil prices offered support, while investors assessed the chances of a Federal Reserve interest rate hike later this year and looked for fresh signals on the US central bank's policy trajectory. Spot gold rose 0.3% to $4,175.60 per ounce by 0259 GMT, while US gold futures for December delivery gained 0.4% to $4,196.40. "Gold is posting a modest rise to start the week. The metal is responding positively to the softer tone in oil prices from an inflation standpoint," said Tim Waterer, chief market analyst at KCM Trade. "In the near term, a more sustained decline in oil prices or a clearer move lower in yields would be the most constructive catalysts (for gold), as both would ease inflation and rate concerns." Oil prices [USN:L1N46406U TEXT:"slipped"] on Monday after US President Donald Trump waived sanctions and tariffs on Russia that may lead to more Russian fuel exports. Meanwhile, US [USN:L1N4620H7 TEXT:"import prices"] increased more than expected in September, boosted by higher costs for energy products and a range of other goods, further evidence of rising inflation pressures as the Middle East conflict persists. Market participants now await the Federal Open Market Committee's meeting on US interest rates and the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) data due next week. The US central bank tracks the PCE price measures for its 2% inflation target. According to the CME's FedWatch Tool, traders are pricing in a 16% chance of a rate hike this month and a 92% chance of an increase in December. While gold is typically considered a hedge against inflation, higher interest rates reduce the appeal of the non-yielding asset. Elsewhere, the [USN:L1N4610ES TEXT:"European Central Bank"] is likely to raise interest rates by 25 basis points at least one more time this year to fight inflationary pressures, the International Monetary Fund said on Friday. Among other metals, spot silver rose 0.9% to $57.54 per ounce, platinum gained 0.7% to $1,642.29 and palladium climbed 1.5% to $1,129.13.

item.title: Flames turn tables on Hurricanes, notch first home win of season
item.description: Yegor Sharangovich scored the go-ahead goal in the third period and Morgan Frost collected one goal and one assist to lead the host Calgary Flames to a 3-2 victory over the high-flying Carolina Hurricanes on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Yegor Sharangovich scored the go-ahead goal in the third period and Morgan Frost collected one goal and one assist to lead the host Calgary Flames to a 3-2 victory over the high-flying Carolina Hurricanes on Sunday. Matvei Gridin also scored for the Flames, who won for only the second time this season and the first time on home ice. Goaltender Devin Cooley made 34 saves, a handful in the final minutes while the Hurricanes had their goalie pulled for the extra attacker. Jesperi Kotkaniemi and Jalen Chatfield replied for the Hurricanes, the defending Stanley Cup champions who had their winning streak snapped at seven games. Goalie Brandon Bussi stopped 31 shots for Carolina, which had won five consecutive road games and arrived after playing Saturday night in Winnipeg. Calgary controlled the bulk of the play in the final frame -- the Flames had a 12-1 edge in shots in the first 10 minutes of the period -- and were rewarded when Sharangovich converted a one-timer from the slot at 15:32 of the period for the winner. Despite sitting at opposite ends of the standings, the clubs battled in a close and entertaining clash. Kotkaniemi opened the scoring with his second goal in as many outings, pouncing on a rebound at 6:09 of the second period. Gridin tied the clash with his first goal of the season. After the Flames survived a lengthy stretch of action in their end -- defenseman Yan Kuznetsov's shift was 3:13 -- Gridin buried a top-shelf shot from the slot with 90 seconds remaining in the middle frame. Frost, playing his 400th NHL game, gave Calgary the lead when he converted a tap-in tally set up by Zayne Parekh for the power-play goal with 20.9 seconds on the clock. However, Chatfield tied the clash with a seeing-eye point shot with four seconds remaining in the second period -- his first goal of the season. Just before the warm-up, the Hurricanes announced forward Mark Jankowski, who had scored in six consecutive games, would miss the game due to a lower-body injury. --Field Level Media

item.title: 午前の日経平均は反落、ＡＩ・半導体株売られ一時6万4000円割れ
item.description: [東京 １９日 ロイター] - 前場の東京株式市場で日経平均は反落し、前営業日比１．２１％（７９０円２６銭）安の６万４５...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
午前の日経平均は反落、ＡＩ・半導体株売られ一時6万4000円割れ 12:01 配信

写真は2020年10月、東京証券取引所で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato

[東京 １９日 ロイター] - 前場の東京株式市場で日経平均は反落し、前営業日比１．２１％（７９０円２６銭）安の６万４５３４円０３銭となった。前週末の米国株式市場が下落したことを受け、朝方からＡＩ（人工知能）・半導体関連株を中心に売り先行の展開となり、前営業日比で一時２．２８％（１４９２円５１銭）安の６万３８３１円７８銭と約１か月ぶりに６万４０００円台を割り込んだ。その後は時間外取引で原油先物価格が下落したことなども手伝い、中盤からは下げ渋った。

・米コアウィーブの社債急落が引き続きＡＩ・半導体株の動きを重くし、前週末の米国株式市場でフィラデルフィア半導体指数（ＳＯＸ）は３．８％安。

・これを受け、日本株もＡＩ・半導体が売られて始まるが、下値では買いが入って下げ渋る。

・原油高からのインフレ懸念再燃で、景気敏感株も軟化したが、ディフェンシブ銘柄が底堅く全体を下支えする。

・ＴＯＰＩＸは０．３９％安の４０５０．３４ポイントで午前の取引を終了。東証プライム市場の売買代金は３兆２７２４億７１００万円。

・東証３３業種では、値上がりは鉱業、海運業、石油・石炭製品など２１業種、値下がりは非鉄金属、電気機器など１２業種。

・個別では、ソフトバンクグループが軟調なほか、ディスコ、レーザーテックなどが大幅安。半面、朝安だったキオクシアホールディングスがプラスに転じ、ＪＴ、オリエンタルランドなどが年初来高値を更新した。

・東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが６５６銘柄（４２％）、値下がりは８４５銘柄（５４％）、変わらずは５０銘柄（３％）。

＜野村証券　ストラテジスト　澤田麻希氏＞

「ＡＩ（人工知能）関連企業の債務問題に加え、原油価格の上昇が株価軟化の要因に。景気敏感株の上値を重くした」

「米国ではインフレ懸念が再び高まってきたことで、相対的に安全性が高い米債に資金がシフトしている様子だ」

「今週後半に本格化する企業の決算発表をきっかけとして、好業績に沿った株価動向の流れになるか注目される」

item.title: 米政府がウクライナ向け衛星通信制限を指示、同国軍の通信速度は大幅低下 ドローン戦で死活問題
item.description: 米国防総省幹部は前週、ウクライナ軍が使用しているスペースXの衛星通信サービス「スターシールド」の速度を落とす必要があると、米ホワイトハウス内部から連絡を受けた。ウクライナ東部で闘うある砲兵部隊にとって、影響は即座に発生。移動中の通信品質の悪化したほか、陣地のネット速度が低下したため司令部や上級部隊との通信が大幅に悪化したという。ドローンが常に脅威となる戦争において、こうした妨害行為は深刻なリスクをもたらす。ある兵士は「トランプ米大統領は当初、極めて短期間で戦争を終わらせると言っていたが、その兆候は全くない」と述べた。

item.title: The Global South is wiring up for an electric future
item.description: The US and Israeli war against Iran has been the big energy story in 2026, but the quiet retooling of power grids from Lagos to Manila may prove to be of greater significance in the long run.
item.dc:creator: Gavin Maguire
item.content:encoded: The US and Israeli war against Iran has been the big energy story in 2026, but the quiet retooling of power grids from Lagos to Manila may prove to be of greater significance in the long run. Emerging economies across Asia, Africa, Latin America and parts of the Middle East have outspent the rest of the world since 2024 on key clean energy components, setting themselves up for further rapid electrification. And these investments extend beyond solar systems to the hardware needed to build power networks that can carry cheap electricity to homes, businesses and vehicles. Since the beginning of 2024, the countries of the Global South have accounted for over half of the worldwide spending on three key sets of China-made technology: grid equipment, cooling systems, and solar arrays, data from think tank Ember shows. This synchronized climb in investments in the components needed to electrify energy systems and scale up electricity distribution indicates broad system-building across emerging markets. Network-wide grid upgrades in turn should make the next phase of electrification both faster and cheaper, as they will allow utilities to better incorporate even more renewable energy supplies, expand energy access to more customers, and allow for improved power flow management across national grids. FOUNDATIONAL GRIDS Solar arrays are cheap and easy to install, and have long been assumed to be the extent of most emerging market forays into the energy transition. But data on import trends of China-made grid equipment reveal that a deeper and more widespread build-out of emerging market power systems is well underway. Spending by economies including India, Pakistan, the Philippines, Brazil, South Africa and Vietnam on imported transformers, switch gear and transmission cables has topped $25.3 billion since the start of 2024, Ember data shows. That compares to $23.8 billion spent on the same components by the rest of the world over that same period, and means that emerging economies have accounted for the lion's share of spending on grid upgrades for most of the past three years. Such heavy spending on grid components means that utilities are signalling serious system-level ambition when it comes to strengthening and extending their power networks, and are readying them for additional growth. A lack of grid infrastructure has historically acted as a bottleneck for renewable energy supplies, so networks with upgraded grids can more easily dial up their renewable energy output levels while keeping electricity supplies flowing. COOLING DOWN Global South economies have also outspent the rest of the world on heating and cooling equipment, with emerging economies spending close to $26 billion since January 2024 compared to $21 billion by the rest of the world. In hot and fast-growing cities, demand for air conditioners is a [USN:L1N3SM0M8 TEXT:"major and rising source of electricity demand"]. While the use of this equipment adds to overall power demand from both clean and fossil fuel sources, the simultaneous build-out of the underlying grid allows utilities to get ahead of that load growth and position the broader system to accommodate greater renewable energy generation. SOLAR, EVS AND THE REST The Global South has spent nearly $47 billion on photovoltaic solar systems since 2024, compared to $37 billion by the rest of the world. That 55.4% share of global spending on Chinese solar systems since the start of 2024 has resulted in a dramatic surge in the deployment of solar power within emerging market electricity systems. Each panel also represents a quantity of fuel that never needs to be imported for power production, and helps boost local support for additional renewable energy deployment going forward. Global South economies have also rapidly increased their imports of Chinese EVs, which shows that their transportation systems are also being electrified at a record pace. Wealthier economies continue to account for a majority of Chinese EV imports, and over the first eight months of 2026 spent $116.5 billion on them, according to Ember. But emerging markets are catching up on that spending, and coughed up $73.2 billion so far this year on imported Chinese EVs. That emerging market spend compares to only $6 billion on Chinese EVs during the same months of 2023, and so highlights how rapidly declining EV costs alongside more accessible charging infrastructure is driving EV uptake in all markets. MIND THE GAP The Global South lags the rest of the world in terms of spending on Chinese battery energy storage systems. Developed economies have accounted for 71% of the total spend on Chinese batteries since 2024, with emerging economies accounting for only 29%. And without batteries, solar-heavy power grids run the risk of widespread curtailment and nightly power price spikes as solar production stops. However, even here the Global South's investments are rising quickly, from around $9 billion during January to August of 2024 to $21 billion during those months this year. Another important aspect of the import data is that it is measured in US dollars, and China's clean tech prices have fallen sharply in recent years. This means that each dollar spent buys more capacity than it did before, and indicates that the physical build-out is likely even larger than the spending figures alone suggest. PERMANENT FIXTURES All told, the economies of the Global South have spent roughly $235 billion on imported Chinese clean energy technology since the start of 2024. Those expenditures have been largely overlooked amid the fallout from the war with Iran, which continues to roil global oil and fuel markets. But throughout the entire conflict — and indeed during the years before it — emerging markets have been laying the foundations for more modern power systems that are less and less reliant on imported fuels for daily use. And if storage capacity, access to finance and local energy policies can keep pace with the hardware already arriving, the Global South has the chance to electrify faster than any region before it. The Hormuz may or may not open fully again. The transformers aren't going anywhere. The opinions expressed here are those of the author , a columnist for Reuters. Enjoying this column? Check out Reuters Open Interest (ROI), your essential new source for global financial commentary. Follow ROI on LinkedIn and X . And listen to the Morning Bid daily podcast on Apple , Spotify , or the Reuters app . Subscribe to hear Reuters journalists discuss the biggest news in markets and finance 7 days a week.

item.title: The week in Asian football
item.description: Talking points from the week in Asian football:
item.dc:creator: Michael Church
item.content:encoded: Talking points from the week in Asian football: AL-QADSIAH GO TOP AFTER SAUDI POSTPONEMENTS Al-Qadsiah moved to the top of the Saudi Pro League with a 2-1 against Abha on Friday following the postponement of matches involving Al-Hilal, Al-Nassr and Al-Ittihad. Mateo Retegui and Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat were on target for Al-Qadsiah, who climbed a point clear of Al-Hilal and a further two points ahead of defending champions Al-Nassr. Saudi Arabia's sporting calendar has been disrupted due to Yemen's Houthi movement firing ballistic missiles and drones at the kingdom's airports, ports and oil installations. CHENGDU LOSE AGAIN TO KEEP TITLE CELEBRATIONS ON HOLD Chengdu Rongcheng squandered another chance to sew up the Chinese Super League title after losing 3-0 to defending champions Shanghai Port on Sunday. Chengdu need one point to win their first league title but have lost their last two matches. Their lead over Dalian Yingbo has been cut to six points with two matches remaining. Chengdu play Dalian on Saturday. KLIMALA SCORES TWICE AS FC SEOUL INCH CLOSER TO TITLE FC Seoul drew 2-2 with Gimcheon Sangmu on Sunday to inch closer to their first K League title since 2016. Patryk Klimala scored twice but Kim In-gyun's 67th-minute penalty denied Seoul all three points. Seoul are 16 points clear of Ulsan HD, who beat Bucheon 2-1, with six matches remaining in the season. HIROSHIMA MOVE INTO TOP SPOT AFTER KASHIWA LOSE Sanfrecce Hiroshima defeated Kyoto Sanga 3-0 on Saturday to go top in the J.League as Kashiwa Reysol slipped from first to fifth following a 3-1 loss to Nagoya Grampus. Kashiwa led the standings going into the weekend but goals from Takuya Uchida, Yudai Kimura and Yuya Yamagishi earned Nagoya the win. Daiki Suga, Akito Suzuki and Mutsuki Kato scored for Hiroshima, who lead Machida Zelvia and FC Tokyo on goal difference. NEW AUCKLAND FC BOSS MOREIRA MAKES WINNING A-LEAGUE START A-League champions Auckland FC made a winning start to the new season on Saturday with a 3-1 victory over Melbourne City. Lachlan Bayliss scored twice as new coach Pedro Moreira kicked off the campaign with a victory following the departure of title-winning boss Steve Corica at the end of last season. Wellington Phoenix launched their campaign with a 2-1 win over Melbourne Victory while Macarthur FC secured a 2-1 victory against Perth Glory.

item.title: 米カリフォルニア州、ＥＶ補助金制度で約1.2万人が初購入
item.description:
David Shepardson
[ワシントン １６日 ロイター] - 米カリフォルニア州は１６日、州と自動車メーカー...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米カリフォルニア州、ＥＶ補助金制度で約1.2万人が初購入 11:58 配信

カリフォルニア州オーシャンサイドにあるショッピングセンターの駐車場に設置された電気自動車（ＥＶ）用充電器。2023年10月撮影。REUTERS/Mike Blake

David Shepardson

[ワシントン １６日 ロイター] - 米カリフォルニア州は１６日、州と自動車メーカーが資金を拠出して設置した総額２億７０００万ドル規模の電気自動車（ＥＶ）購入者向け補助金制度に関し、８月以降に約１万２０００人がこの補助金を活用してＥＶを購入したと発表した。

ただ、トランプ米政権（共和党）がＥＶ購入に対する連邦政府の優遇措置を廃止したため、カリフォルニア州を含めた全米でのＥＶ販売台数は全体的に減少している。この動きは、原油価格の高騰を背景に世界でＥＶの販売台数が伸びているのと逆行している。

カリフォルニア州のニューサム州知事（民主党）が署名して７月に法制化された補助金制度では、州民が初めてＥＶを購入する際に、小売価格が５万ドル以下の新車ＥＶに対して３５００ドル、２万５０００ドル以下の中古ＥＶに対しては１７５０ドルをそれぞれ支給する。

カリフォルニア州によると、９月３０日までの同州における総販売台数に占めるＥＶの比率は１８％となり、これは昨年の２３％、２０２４年の２５％から低下した。同州で販売されたＥＶの半数以上を米ＥＶ大手テスラ の車両が占めている。

これまでに計約７０００万ドルが支出され、新車ＥＶ１万１８０６台と中古ＥＶ１３２台が購入された。補助金資金には２億ドルが残っている。

メーカー別では、テスラが５６５８台、韓国の現代自動車 が１７００台、トヨタ自動車が１４００台、米ゼネラル・モーターズ（ＧＭ） １１００台。日産自動車 が新たに資金拠出に加わり、三菱自動車 は１１月から参加する予定だ。

他に米フォード・モーター とルーシッド・グループ、リビアン・オートモーティブ 、トヨタの高級車ブランド「レクサス」、ホンダ 、ＳＵＢＡＲＵ（スバル） 、韓国の起亜、スウェーデンのボルボも参加している。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 焦点：トランプ政権の影で歩み寄るカナダとＥＵ、準加盟提示でも見える限界 最終更新: 10/19(月) 11:58 ロイター

item.title: Putin proposes summit with Trump and Xi to discuss Ukraine deal, WSJ says
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin has proposed a summit next month with US President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping to negotiate an end to the four-year-old Ukraine conflict that would favour Moscow, the Wall Street Journal reported on Sunday, citing people familiar with the discussions.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Russian President Vladimir Putin has proposed a summit next month with US President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping to negotiate an end to the four-year-old Ukraine conflict that would favour Moscow, the Wall Street Journal reported on Sunday, citing people familiar with the discussions. The proposed summit comes amid warming ties between Trump and Putin especially after the US President announced a [USN:L4N45Y0AR TEXT:"deal"] to buy Russian diesel and [USN:L6N464042 TEXT:"signed"] an order on Friday waiving key sanctions on Moscow. Citing a former Russian intelligence officer briefed on the matter, the paper said that Putin's suggestion came in an October 9 telephone call with Trump that also yielded the diesel deal between the two countries. The White House did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment, while the Kremlin could not be immediately reached outside regular business hours. The Russian and Chinese embassies in Washington did not immediately reply to requests for comment. The Kremlin has suggested holding the trilateral dialogue on the sidelines of the upcoming Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit, the WSJ report said, citing people familiar with the discussions. That summit is set to take place on November 18 to 19 in Shenzhen. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov confirmed to the Journal that discussions were taking place over a potential meeting. “There is no clear understanding yet regarding the meeting itself or its potential agenda, although all three parties acknowledge the hypothetical possibility of such a meeting taking place,” he told the Wall Street Journal. A senior US official told the Journal that Trump had not agreed to such a summit, but he could be receptive to the idea. Trump's diesel deal with Putin and the executive order waiving sanctions on Moscow have drawn criticism from Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy, who has warned it would embolden Putin and prolong the war.

item.title: トランプ氏、首都ゴルフ場の改修着手表明 裁判所命令にもかかわらず
item.description: [１８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１８日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１８日、連邦裁判所から「事前の裁判所への通知なしには改修を進めてはならない」との命令が出ていたワシントンの歴史的なゴルフコースについて、来月から改修に着手すると述べた。

トランプ氏が９月に開始すると述べていたこの改修は、環境保護などに関する懸念を巡って訴訟の対象となっていた。

同氏は自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」への投稿で、「イースト・ポトマック・ゴルフ・リンクス」での工事が１１月１５日に始まり、約１５カ月後に再開されると記した。この改修工事は、ホワイトハウスやワシントンのその他ランドマークを刷新するためにトランプ氏が推進している複数のプロジェクトの一つ。

裁判所は今年、ゴルフ場での実質的な建設工事を進める前に政府が通知を行う必要があるとの判断を下し、先週には同敷地内での樹木伐採を停止する命令を出していた。

また、政府は１６日、本件の訴訟を別の判事に移管するよう求める申し立てを提出。裁判資料によると、政府は担当判事の行動が「トランプ政権に対する根深く、明白な反感」を示していると主張した。

item.title: China's new home prices fall again in September as recovery stays elusive
item.description: China's new home prices fell again in September, marking more than three years without a monthly or annual increase, suggesting policy support has yet to generate a broad-based recovery in housing demand.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China's new home prices fell again in September, marking more than three years without a monthly or annual increase, suggesting policy support has yet to generate a broad-based recovery in housing demand. New home prices dropped 0.1% month on month, matching the pace of decline in August, according to Reuters calculations based on data released by the National Bureau of Statistics. On an annual basis, prices fell 2.8%, narrowing from a 3.0% drop in August, extending a decline since June 2023. The housing market's prolonged downturn has become one of China's biggest economic challenges, depressing consumer confidence and local government revenues. Prices of new and resale homes in the country's biggest cities continued to show signs of stabilisation, likely boosted by [USN:P8N43C00W TEXT:"Shanghai's"] further easing of homebuying restrictions and incentives such as subsidies announced in August. In smaller cities, however, both new and resale home prices continued to fall month on month and year on year. In a sign that policymakers are seeking to prop up the housing market in smaller cities, the central bank and financial regulator [USN:L1N45L0BK TEXT:"unveiled"] in late September policies for subsidising mortgage interest payments for eligible homebuyers. The policy capped the purchase price of eligible homes at 1.5 million yuan ($224,417), hardly enough to pay for even a one-bedroom apartment in a tier-one city. Market woes continue to act as a drag on domestic demand, as many homeowners, seeing the value of their homes fall, opt to save money rather than spend. Separate [USN:P8N45900O TEXT:"data"] showed property investment and home sales both contracted at a faster pace in the first nine months of the year. ($1 = 6.6840 Chinese yuan)

item.title: 英当局、米マイクロソフトの業務用ソフトを「戦略的市場地位」に指定
item.description:
Paul Sandle Yadarisa Shabong
[ロンドン １６日 ロイター] - 英規制当局の競争・市場庁...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英当局、米マイクロソフトの業務用ソフトを「戦略的市場地位」に指定 11:44 配信

写真はマイクロソフトのロゴ。2025年3月、フランス・パリ近郊で撮影。REUTERS/Gonzalo Fuentes

Paul Sandle　Yadarisa Shabong

[ロンドン １６日 ロイター] - 英規制当局の競争・市場庁（ＣＭＡ）は１６日、業務用ソフトウエア分野で米マイクロソフトを「戦略的市場地位」に指定することを提案した。これにより、マイクロソフトの表計算ソフト「エクセル」や会議アプリ「マイクロソフト　チームス」、人工知能（ＡＩ）アシスタント「マイクロソフト　コパイロット」などをセットで販売する手法にＣＭＡが介入する道が開かれた。

ＣＭＡのサラ・カーデル最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は「あらゆる組織は自らのために最適な製品を選択し、希望に応じてプロバイダーを切り替え、異なるサプライヤーのサービスを組み合わせることが可能であるべきだ」とし、「私たちは企業がマイクロソフトの製品と他の選択肢をどのように併用するかについて、自由に選択できることを確実にしたいと考えている」とコメントした。

英国ではマイクロソフトのソフトが月間約２０００万人に利用されている。ＣＭＡは５月、マイクロソフトのソフトでの地位が競争を阻害していないかどうかについて調査に乗り出していた。

調査の結果、マイクロソフトがパソコン用基本ソフト（ＯＳ）や、生産性向上とセキュリティー、サーバー、データベース管理のそれぞれのソフト分野で強固な地位を占めており、顧客が他社製品に乗り換える際に直面する障壁によって優越性が一段と強まっているとの見解を示した。

マイクロソフトの広報担当者は、ＣＭＡの見解に同意できないとして「コパイロットを含む当社の全ての製品はオープンで相互運用性が高く、顧客は競合サービスと併用することが可能だ」との声明を出した。

これに対してＣＭＡは、顧客がＡＩツールを自由に選択できるかどうかや、競合他社がコパイロットと競うことが可能かどうかを調査するとコメントした。

また、マイクロソフトによるセキュリティー製品のセット販売が選択肢を制限していないかどうかや、同社のライセンスを巡る慣行が顧客のクラウド利用の選択肢にどのような影響を与えているかについても検証すると説明している。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：債務膨張の先進国に金融危機の芽、最も懸念される米・伊・英 コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か アングル：マイクロソフト、一時撤退検討の中国市場に踏みとどまった理由 アングル：英新財務相、実務手腕に一定評価も支出拡大・増税不安消えず アングル：スペースＸの宇宙データセンター、ＭＳ「海中」計画中止が示す高いハードル 最終更新: 10/19(月) 11:44 ロイター

item.title: VIEW China's economic growth accelerates to 4.5% in third quarter
item.description: China's economic growth rebounded to 4.5% year-on-year in the third quarter, beating expectations and easing the pressure on policymakers for delivering more aggressive stimulus measures to meet the annual target.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China's economic growth [USN:L1N46501H TEXT:"rebounded"] to 4.5% year-on-year in the third quarter, beating expectations and easing the pressure on policymakers for delivering more aggressive stimulus measures to meet the annual target. The third-quarter gross domestic product growth rate, released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Monday, beat the forecast for 4.4% growth in a Reuters poll, and improved from the more-than-three-year low of 4.3% in the April-to-June period. KEY POINTS * Q3 GDP +4.5% y/y (f'cast +4.4%, Q2 +4.3%) * Q3 GDP +1.2% q/q (f'cast +1.1%, Q2 +0.9%) * September industrial output +5.5% y/y (f'cast +5.5%, August +5.2%) * September retail sales +1.1% y/y (forecast +0.6%, August +0.4%) * January-September fixed asset investment -7.2% y/y (forecast -7.3%, January-August -7.2%) * January-September property investment -20.6% y/y (January-August -19.9%) COMMENTARY ZHIWEI ZHANG, CHIEF ECONOMIST, PINPOINT ASSET MANAGEMENT, HONG KONG: "The economic momentum remained subdued in September. The retail sales growth rebounded slightly. After adjusting for inflation, real retail sales barely grew compared to a year ago. The GDP growth rate in Q3 rebounded to 4.5%. The GDP growth rate for the first three quarters combined grew by 4.6%, which is still above the lower end of the growth target zone. I wonder if this means that the government doesn't need to make significant change to the policy stance in Q4 to achieve the growth target for the full year." RAYMOND YEUNG, CHIEF CHINA ECONOMIST, ANZ, HONG KONG: "Overall, we maintain our 2026 GDP growth forecast at 4.6%, but risks remain tilted to the downside. Weak domestic demand, persistent deflationary pressure and an ongoing property downturn continue to constrain activity. "While exports have provided an important buffer, they are unlikely to fully offset softness elsewhere in the economy. Growth has stabilised, but it has not yet entered a self-sustaining recovery." HO WOEI CHEN, ECONOMIST, UOB, SINGAPORE: "External demand is still keeping the economy afloat, and I think that is also why the government is not really very aggressive in the stimulus. "We see some targeted support here and there, but broad-based easing is not very likely at this point because I think growth is still on target at the bottom of the forecast range. "Our forecast now is 4.5%." ANDY JI, ASIAN FX & RATES ANALYST, ITC MARKETS, SHANGHAI: "China’s Q3 print beat on both the YoY and QoQ measures. The result puts China's full-year 4.5%-5% growth target within reach, though still requiring a strong Q4. High-tech manufacturing, chip output, NEVs, and export delivery values reflect a competitive industrial upgrading that is real and accelerating. "However, the growth composition remains deeply unbalanced... Growth is export- and state-led; domestic demand is not yet self-sustaining, and the property sector shows no floor. "The GDP beat and retail sales surprise reduce the urgency for immediate broad-based easing. The PBOC has kept its policy rate steady since a cut in May 2025. While monetary policy is effectively on hold, the active policy debate is fiscal." BACKGROUND * China's economic growth has remained resilient this year, supported by booming AI-driven exports and robust manufacturing output, but underlying momentum remains uneven as households stay cautious, private firms rein in investment and the property sector struggles to stabilise. * Exports, a key driver of growth, face mounting headwinds as a cooling AI investment cycle threatens demand for technology products and components. * A deal with the European Union to curb Chinese hybrid-vehicle shipments could also weigh on one of the country's fastest-growing export industries. * The disconnect between robust industrial output and weak domestic demand has emerged as a key challenge for policymakers seeking to rebalance the economy. * China is likely to rely more on fiscal stimulus to support growth, as firmer producer prices and a pickup in consumer inflation limit the scope for aggressive monetary easing. * Growth is expected to [USN:L4N4600PL TEXT:"slow"] to 4.5% in 2026 from 5.0% last year, before easing further to 4.4% in 2027, according to a Reuters poll.

item.title: マクロスコープ：「デフレ世代」と「インフレ世代」、エコノミストの賃上げ観に微妙な温度差
item.description:
Kentaro Sugiyama
［東京 １９日 ロイター］ - 日本経済の成長持続性を見極める上でカギとなる２０２７...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
マクロスコープ：「デフレ世代」と「インフレ世代」、エコノミストの賃上げ観に微妙な温度差 11:38 配信

都内で8月撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato

Kentaro Sugiyama

［東京　１９日　ロイター］ - 日本経済の成長持続性を見極める上でカギとなる２０２７年春闘。賃上げ率（定期昇給込み）は４％台後半と予想する向きが多いが、エコノミストの間でも微妙に温度差があることに気づく。就職氷河期を経験した「デフレ世代」が慎重姿勢になりがちな一方、若手の「インフレ世代」からはやや強気な声が聞かれる。それぞれが社会人となった時代の違いに加え、人工知能（ＡＩ）などの影響をどう見積もるかも、その温度差につながっている可能性がある。

「私はインフレ世代ですので」。２０代半ばの若手エコノミスト、ＳＭＢＣ日興証券の宮田皓生氏はこう語る。賃上げ動向の見通しはチーム内でもやや温度差があり、上の世代ほど慎重な見方が多いと感じているという。来年の春闘に関する個人的な見立てでは、今年並みの３％台半ばのベースアップ率は維持される可能性が高く、さらに上振れする余地もあるとみる。定昇込みの賃上げ率が５％を上回るのも「十分にあり得る」とみる。

人手不足が構造的に続く中、企業は物価上昇を背景に価格転嫁を進め、名目収益を拡大させている。労働者も実質賃金の目減りに敏感になっており、賃上げ圧力はなお強いという。

一方、氷河期世代と重なるシニアやチーフクラスのエコノミストには慎重な見方が少なくない。企業が人材の確保やつなぎ止めのために賃上げせざるを得ない環境にあるという状況認識は共有しつつも、賃上げの継続はそれほど簡単ではないとの感覚もにじむ。デフレ下で社会人生活を送り、物価も賃金も上がらない時代を経験したことが影響していそうだ。

別の３０代前半の民間エコノミストは「氷河期世代が悲観的になりがちなのは仕方がない面もあるのでは。エコノミストを始めてからずっと日本経済はほぼ成長していなかった。急に成長する絵を描けと言われても、難しい気もする」と話す。一方、氷河期世代の上の世代にあたる、「バブル期」を経験した現在役員クラスとなったエコノミストからは「若手よりもっと強気に感じる」こともあるという。

＜世代効果＞

一口に「就職氷河期世代」といっても、定義には幅がある。内閣府の資料では、１９９０年代の成長鈍化の影響を受けた１９７４年から１９８３年生まれを指すことが多い。政府の就職氷河期世代支援策は、おおむね１９９３─２００４年に学校卒業期を迎えた世代としている。

自身も４０代後半で氷河期世代にあたり、同世代を分析した著作がある日本総研の下田裕介・主任研究員は、デフレ期を社会人として過ごした世代には「物価も賃金もなかなか上がらない」というイメージが強いと指摘。一方、デフレを知らない若い世代は、物価や賃金の上昇が特別なものではないと受け止めやすいという。

統計学やマーケティング、社会学などで使われる「世代効果」という分析用語がある。生まれた世代が同じであることで共通して表れる特有の価値観や行動パターンのことだ。下田氏は、エコノミストの予測はあくまでデータに基づいて行うものだが、自身が経験した経済・社会環境を完全に切り離して考えることは難しいと指摘する。

４０代前半で氷河期世代のやや下の世代にあたる大和証券の末広徹チーフエコノミストは、就職は比較的しやすかったが、賃金は低水準で抑えられていたと指摘。多くの人にとって賃上げが当たり前との感覚が広がり始めたのは、アベノミクス以降の「官製春闘」が定着してからであり、賃金観については、世代で切り分けることは容易ではないと話す。

＜ＡＩがもたらす変化は＞

社会人となった時代や経験の違いは、社会の変化をどう評価するかにも影響する。代表的なのはＡＩの捉え方だ。日本ではＡＩ需要を背景とした半導体需要の拡大やデータセンターの整備などが注目されているが、中期的には人々の働き方を変える力を持つ。

大和証の末広氏は、経験や専門知識を持つ人材ほどＡＩを活用しやすく、企業は従来以上に高度な知識や分析力を持つ人材を求めるようになるとの見方を示す。その場合、情報収集やデータ整理といった業務の一部はＡＩに代替されても、深い分析や独自の視点を示せるシニア人材の価値はむしろ高まる可能性があるという。

一方、若手の「下積み」的な業務が減り、経験を積む機会が失われる可能性もある。一般的に初任給が引き上げられていく傾向にある中、高い賃金水準に見合う人材育成をどう進めるかも企業の課題となりそうだ。

労働組合の全国中央組織、連合は２７年春闘に向けた基本構想を２２日に発表する。２６年の賃上げ率は５．０１％と３年連続で５％台を確保したが、２７年は物価高が続く中、一部の中小企業の息切れなども予想され、４％台後半で着地するとの見方が多い。

物価も賃金も上がらない時代を知る「デフレ世代」と、それをそれほど知らない「インフレ世代」。来年の春闘は、どちらの見立てに軍配が上がるのか試す場にもなるかもしれない。

item.title: Rupee likely pinned near 95 as RBI defence counters oil headwinds
item.description: The Indian rupee is likely to be under pressure from high oil prices at Monday's open, with the central bank's dollar sales expected to support the currency and keep it near what traders perceive to be the central bank's soft defence line.
item.dc:creator: Nimesh Vora
item.content:encoded: The Indian rupee is likely to be under pressure from high oil prices at Monday's open, with the central bank's dollar sales expected to support the currency and keep it near what traders perceive to be the central bank's soft defence line. The rupee is expected to open in a 94.92 to 94.98 range, per traders, having settled at 94.96 to the dollar on Friday. The rupee has oscillated around the 95-per-dollar mark in recent sessions, briefly strengthening past the level before struggling to sustain it. Subsequent declines past that level have repeatedly met resistance. The pattern suggests that the Reserve Bank of India may be selling dollars to limit weakness past the 95 level, making the level an important near-term support for the currency, a currency trader at a bank said. The rupee last week posted its best weekly performance in nearly four years, buoyed by the RBI’s measures to support the currency and repeated dollar sales in the spot market. The RBI has stepped up its intervention to prop up the rupee, which remains under pressure from oil prices and capital outflows. The central bank's stepped-up defence of the rupee alongside sell/buy swaps is reflected in foreign exchange reserves. The country’s reserves have shed nearly $60 billion since hitting an all-time high in the first week of September, falling to $726 billion through October 9. OIL A PAIN POINT Oil remains a key pressure point for the rupee, with Brent crude briefly climbing above $110 a barrel on Friday for the first time since May. Prices dipped slightly on Monday, with Brent trading around $108 a barrel after US President Donald Trump waived new sanctions on Russia and tariffs on good from Russia, potentially paving the way for increased Russian fuel exports. There is broad consensus among analysts and investors that the RBI's efforts to support the rupee will go only so far unless oil prices retreat.

item.title: カナダ中銀、原油高でインフレ見通し大幅引き上げへ 総裁が表明
item.description:
Promit Mukherjee
[オタワ １７日 ロイター] - カナダ銀行（中央銀行）のマックレム総裁は１７日、原...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
カナダ中銀、原油高でインフレ見通し大幅引き上げへ　総裁が表明 11:29 配信

写真はカナダ銀行（中央銀行）のマックレム総裁。2026年10月16日、タイ・バンコクで撮影。REUTERS/Patipat Janthong

Promit Mukherjee

[オタワ １７日 ロイター] - カナダ銀行（中央銀行）のマックレム総裁は１７日、原油と石油製品の価格が高止まりしていることを受け、今月公表する四半期のインフレ見通しを大幅に引き上げる見込みだと明らかにした。バンコクからの電話会議で記者団に語った。

最新のインフレ・成長率見通しは２８日の金融政策決定に反映される。

マックレム氏は、「（中東で）紛争が続き、エネルギー関連の輸送が依然制約を受け、製油能力も損なわれている。インフレが幅広い分野に波及し、長期化するリスクは高まっている」と表明。その上で「われわれの指針は２％というインフレ率目標だ。長期的にインフレ率を目標に近い水準に維持すべく取り組んでおり、必要に応じて金融政策を調整する用意がある」と述べた。

２８日に決める金融政策については「われわれが自らに問いかけるのは、インフレ率が自然に低下して目標に近づくと見込めるのか、それともインフレの動きを変え、目標に向かうよう促すために利上げが必要なのかという点だ」と説明した。

金融市場ではこの数カ月、カナダ中銀が利上げするとの観測が強まってきた。ただ、市場は１７日現在、２８日、１２月ともに据え置きを見込んでいる。一方で市場は、来年を通じて計１００ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げを織り込んでもいる。

マックレム氏は、中東紛争やロシア・ウクライナ戦争が続く中、世界経済は底堅さを示してきたが、コストの上昇と金融環境の引き締まりによって耐性が試されていると指摘。また、各国政府は財政面で政策対応に使える余地が縮小しており、財政余力を回復するために政策を調整する必要があるとの認識を示した。その上で、中銀当局者にとって最大の懸念は、原油や石油製品の価格上昇が経済全体に波及するかどうかを見極めることだと訴えた。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：トランプ政権の影で歩み寄るカナダとＥＵ、準加盟提示でも見える限界 焦点：カナダ首相の対米強硬姿勢に高い国内支持、貿易戦争長期化で風向き一変も 焦点：中国車メーカー、カナダ進出に本腰　米市場開放にらみ「予行演習」 アングル：アルバータ州、天然ガスでデータセンター誘致　カナダ政府の環境政策と対立 焦点：カナダ、トランプ関税後の新貿易秩序に布石　中国などと協定加速 最終更新: 10/19(月) 11:29 ロイター

item.title: Em primeiro debate, Flávio e Lula trocam ataques sobre Lulinha e Vorcaro
item.description: O primeiro debate entre os candidatos à Presidência Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) e Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), na noite deste domingo, foi marcado por diversas trocas de ataques e momentos de tensão, com o senador acusando o filho do presidente de irregularidades enquanto o candidato à reeleição cobrou explicações do adversário sobre as relações com o banqueiro preso Daniel Vorcaro.
item.dc:creator: Eduardo Simões
item.content:encoded: O primeiro debate entre os candidatos à Presidência Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) e Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), na noite deste domingo, foi marcado por diversas trocas de ataques e momentos de tensão, com o senador acusando o filho do presidente de irregularidades enquanto o candidato à reeleição cobrou explicações do adversário sobre as relações com o banqueiro preso Daniel Vorcaro. O candidato do PL insistiu desde o início em vincular Lula à advogada Roberta Luchsinger, investigada pela Polícia Federal no escândalo do INSS e ligada a Fábio Luiz Lula da Silva, filho mais velho de Lula. O presidente, por sua vez, cobrou que Flávio desse explicações sobre suas relações com o banqueiro Daniel Vorcaro, do Banco Master, e os pedidos de recursos que fez a ele para o filme "Dark Horse", sobre a vida de seu pai, Jair Bolsonaro. "Lula, você conhece Roberta Luchsinger?", questionou Flávio logo no início do debate promovido pela TV Band. Na véspera, a CNN Brasil veiculou uma entrevista de Luchsinger na qual a lobista fez acusações contra Lulinha e Lula. O presidente respondeu que cabe à Polícia Federal investigar a advogada. "Quero ver no depoimento se ela vai contar as mentiras que ela contou ontem", disse Lula, que, por sua vez, disse a Flávio várias vezes que explicasse o pedido de R$134 milhões feito a Vorcaro para o filme "Dark Horse". "Eu já dei as explicações que tinha que dar", disse Flávio em relação ao caso "Dark Horse". Lula chegou a propor um "desafio" a Flávio, em que os dois abrissem suas contas bancárias e de seus familiares, assim como seus sigilos telefônicos, para que "o povo saiba quem é ladrão neste país". Flávio rebateu acusando Lula de receber dinheiro "por fora" e que portanto não estaria em sua conta bancária. Em um dos momentos de tensão, os dois ficaram a centímetros um do outro e Flávio cobrou que Lula o respeitasse. "Você me respeita que eu tive 56 milhões de votos. Estou esfregando umas verdades na sua cara... O Brasil vai te aposentar", disse Flávio. Lula, por sua vez, lembrou que o senador é alvo de investigações e disse que essas investigações vão avançar se Flávio perder as eleições. "Você vai perder a imunidade e a sua vida tem muito inquérito que agora vai andar", afirmou. O presidente também reclamou que o senador não respondia ao que era perguntado e abordava assuntos diferentes do que haviam sido abordados no questionamento ao responder. As regras do debate permitiam que os candidatos se movimentassem livremente pelo palco, o que Flávio fez muito mais do que Lula, muitas vezes reagindo com gestos e expressões faciais às falas do petista, o que gerou tensão em diversos momentos. "Se ele estiver zombando de mim, eu quero direito de resposta, porque eu não sou palhaço, quem é palhaço aqui é ele", disparou Lula aos mediadores em um momento em que percebeu a movimentação de Flávio atrás de si. Flávio pediu alguns direitos de resposta, por exemplo quando Lula disse que não ficaria perto dele pois queria "distância de miliciano" e quando o presidente o chamou de "malandro carioca". Em uma dessas vezes foi concedido direito de resposta ao senador. Ao ouvir de Lula que não queria ficar perto dele, Flávio disse que isso seria bom pois assim não corria risco de ter sua carteira roubada. O senador também chamou Lula de "corrupto". SAÚDE E DÍVIDAS CONGELADAS Em um debate, no geral, sem muitas propostas de ambas as partes, Flávio disse que daria ao Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS) o padrão do hospital Albert Einstein, ao que Lula questionou se ele pretendia privatizar o SUS. Em uma pergunta dos mediadores sobre saúde, o senador fez, em suas palavras, um "mea culpa" sobre o desempenho do governo de seu pai no setor. "De fato, a saúde não foi uma área que a gente teve o melhor resultado durante o governo do presidente Bolsonaro, eu faço aqui esse mea culpa", disse Flávio. Lula lembrou os mais de 700 mil mortos na pandemia e o comportamento de Bolsonaro durante a pandemia de Covid-19. Ao bater na tecla do endividamento das famílias brasileiras, Flávio prometeu que, se eleito, congelará as dívidas de pessoas físicas por seis meses e de pessoas jurídicas por um ano. "No meu governo a gente vai comprar a sua dívida dos bancos", disse Flávio. "Para você que é pessoa física, vai ficar seis meses congelada, parada, a sua dívida, você não vai pagar boleto nenhum. E para você que é pessoa jurídica, esse prazo vai ser de um ano, um ano sem pagar seus boletos", prometeu. Em resposta, Lula lembrou que na nova fase do programa Desenrola, o governo irá comprar dívidas que as pessoas têm nos bancos com descontos da ordem de 90% e afirmou, ironicamente, que Flávio tem acompanhado o que tem sido feito por seu governo. O senador, por várias vezes, responsabilizou Lula pelo endividamento das famílias e acusou o governo de gastar demais. Lula, por sua vez, perguntou se Flávio adotará o modelo econômico do presidente da Argentina, Javier Milei, e apontou o aumento da pobreza no país vizinho. O presidente prometeu ainda que cuidará do povo brasileiro "com muita responsabilidade fiscal".

item.title: Indian shares muted as investors assess key earnings against elevated oil prices
item.description: Indian shares opened little changed on Monday, with investors assessing the results of top private lenders HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank , while elevated crude prices weighed on risk sentiment.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Indian shares opened little changed on Monday, with investors assessing the results of top private lenders HDFC Bank (HDBK.NS) and ICICI Bank (ICBK.NS) , while elevated crude prices weighed on risk sentiment. The benchmark Nifty 50 (.NSEI) fell 0.02% to 23,140.5, while the BSE Sensex (.BSESN) edged 0.05% lower to 74,691.38, as of 09:18 a.m. IST. Eleven of the 16 major sectors logged gains. The broader small-caps (.NIFSMCP100) and mid-caps (.NIFMDCP100) shed 0.2% and 0.1%, respectively.

item.title: China's economy picks up pace in Q3 as exports power uneven recovery
item.description: China's economy grew faster than expected in the third quarter as a surge in exports and strong factory activity offset persistent weakness in domestic demand, easing pressure on policymakers to roll out more forceful stimulus measures.
item.dc:creator: Kevin Yao, Ellen Zhang, Yukun Zhang
item.content:encoded: China's economy grew faster than expected in the third quarter as a surge in exports and strong factory activity offset persistent weakness in domestic demand, easing pressure on policymakers to roll out more forceful stimulus measures. The 4.5% growth rate, released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Monday, beat the forecast for 4.4% growth in a Reuters [USN:L4N4600PL TEXT:"poll"], and improved from the more-than-three-year [USN:L1N43H01A TEXT:"low"] of 4.3% in the April-to-June period. The stronger headline growth was underpinned by a surge in [USN:L6N4600GE TEXT:"exports"], with China's trade surplus widening more than expected in September and keeping the country on track to surpass last year's record $1.2 trillion surplus. September activity data also showed signs of improvement. Retail sales rose a better-than-expected 1.1% from a year earlier, accelerating from August's 0.4% increase and marking the fastest growth since March. Consumer spending remained subdued overall, however, highlighting the uneven nature of the recovery. Industrial output grew 5.5% in September, up from 5.2% in August and marking the strongest pace in six months, underscoring the continued resilience of the manufacturing sector. Policymakers have held back from rolling out broad-based stimulus, betting that robust exports, boosted by the global AI-driven tech boom, will keep growth on track to meet the annual target of 4.5%-5.0%. For January-September, the economy grew 4.6%, within the range of the government's growth. "The key macroeconomic message is that China's economy is still supply- and production-side driven," said Yuhan Zhang, principal economist at The Conference Board's China Center. "This supports near-term growth and industrial upgrading, while continued efforts to strengthen household consumption, services demand, and consumer confidence would make the recovery more balanced and sustainable." Beijing has leaned heavily on exports for growth this year, but that engine faces growing pressure as domestic demand remains weak and trade tensions with the European Union escalate. A deal with the EU to rein in Chinese hybrid-vehicle shipments could weigh on the booming auto trade. China's strategy of redirecting credit and resources from property towards high-tech industries has created a two-speed economy, where strong factory output and exports mask weak consumption and private investment. BEIJING LEANS ON FISCAL SUPPORT On a quarterly basis, the economy expanded 1.2% in the third quarter, surpassing expectations for a 1.1% rise and accelerating from 0.9% in April-June. According to Mao Shengyong, deputy head of the NBS, new growth drivers, including high-end manufacturing, the digital economy and modern services, contributed more than 40% to economic growth in the first three quarters. Beijing has recently expanded support for home buyers, unveiled [USN:L1N45L0BK TEXT:"measures"] to steer cheaper credit into sectors including infrastructure and technology and allocated 550 billion yuan ($82.28 billion) in unused government debt quotas to ease local governments' financial strain and expand infrastructure investment. Authorities also stepped up fiscal support, including [USN:L1N44I01C TEXT:"expanding"] loan interest subsidies for small private firms and consumers and [USN:L4N44L0KU TEXT:"tapping"] an 800 billion yuan policy-based financing tool to spur infrastructure investment. Still, infrastructure investment shrank 4.2%. Fixed-asset investment declined 7.2% in the first nine months, dropping at the same pace as in the January-to-August period. "Improved government investment helped arrest the consistent worsening in fixed asset investment," said Tianchen Xu, senior economist at the Economist Intelligence Unit. Investment in property, however, remained weak, [USN:P8N45900O TEXT:"falling 20.6%"] in the first nine months of the year. ($1 = 6.6846 Chinese yuan renminbi)

item.title: China's economic growth accelerates to 4.5% in third quarter
item.description: China's economic growth in Q3 is an improvement on the more-than-three-year low of 4.3 per cent in the April-to-June period.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Business

China's economic growth accelerates to 4.5% in third quarter

China's economic growth in Q3 is an improvement on the more-than-three-year low of 4.3 per cent in the April-to-June period.

A view of the city skyline in Beijing, China. (Photo: Reuters/Tingshu Wang)

FAST

BEIJING: China's economic growth rebounded to 4.5 per cent year-on-year in the third quarter, beating expectations and easing the pressure on policymakers to deliver more aggressive stimulus measures to meet the annual target. The third-quarter gross domestic product growth rate, released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Monday (Oct 19), beat the forecast for 4.4 per cent growth in a Reuters poll, and improved from the more-than-three-year low of 4.3 per cent in the April-to-June period . Beijing has leaned heavily on exports for growth this year, but that engine faces growing pressure as domestic demand remains weak and trade tensions with the European Union escalate. China's strategy of redirecting credit and resources from property towards high-tech industries has created a two-speed economy, where strong factory output and exports mask weak consumption and private investment.
